description: This file defines the KafkaClient class within the Aws\Kafka namespace, which extends the AwsClient class. It provides method signatures and documentation for interacting with the Managed Streaming for Kafka service in AWS, including methods for creating, deleting, describing, and managing Kafka clusters and configurations.
